secret.label: A child boarded out
secret.description: Klara Hochstetter goes to the back room at Mrs. Teague’s from 7:30 PM to see a child nobody is supposed to know about.

secret.label: Fencing stolen goods
secret.description: Odessa Tillman hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at Mancuso’s pool hall from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

secret.label: Murder
secret.description: Roscoe Dandridge is at the victim’s suite at the residential hotel from 10:30 PM, alone with Vincenzo Grasso when it happens at 10:30 PM.

coverSecret.label: Blackmailing the victim
coverSecret.description: Roscoe Dandridge meets the victim alone at the vestibule of the Hallam apartments from 8:30 PM and asks for money.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

people.name: Teresa Salerno
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.label: Forged identity
secret.description: Teresa Salerno is not the person the papers say. Nothing about the evening is hidden; the lie is all in the paperwork.

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Nunzio Lanza slips off to Mancuso’s pool hall from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

motive.description: blamed the victim for a ruin

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Gretchen Steinbach slips off to Mancuso’s pool hall from 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

method.name: poison in a drink
method.bodyEvidence: Chloral hydrate in the stomach. No wound, no bruising, no sign of a struggle.

anchors.name: the fuse going in the building

traces.description: a crack in the cellar and every light on the riser out at once
candle smoke on the ceilings of everyone who sat it out

anchors.sceneTiming: the lights on that riser were dead from then until the morning

anchors.name: the El going over

traces.description: everything under the structure stops being audible for twenty seconds

anchors.timing: just as the El went over
anchors.sceneTiming: the El was running to timetable and it covers the half hour exactly

anchors.name: the beat cop’s pass
anchors.sceneTiming: the patrolman was two streets off on his round and heard it
